figurative_meaning_en: Firmly resolved or having arrived at a firm decision
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় উত্তীর্ণ হওয়ার জন্য ছাত্রটি কৃতসঙ্কল্প।
example_sentences_in_english: He is firmly resolved to leave the country.
The student is determined to pass the exam.
note: This idiom is often used in literary or formal contexts to denote unwavering commitment.
